test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

She found fault in every sentence of the exercise sheet that I asimilated from prior observations.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"asimilated"** is misspelled and should be "assimilated".

 
 
• English Meaning: To take in and understand fully (information or ideas). (समाहित करना)
 
• **Example: **He **assimilated** the information presented in the lecture very quickly.
 
 
 
• The correct word is **"assimilated"**.
 
 
• Hindi Meaning: (समाहित करना)
 
• **Example: **She** assimilated **all the new concepts taught in the class.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fault** (त्रुटि): An unattractive or unsatisfactory feature, especially in a piece of work or in a person’s character.

 
 
• **Example:** She found a fault in every sentence of the exercise sheet.
 
 
 
• **Prior** (पूर्व): Existing or coming before in time, order, or importance.
 
 
• **Example:** He had no prior experience in this field.
 
 
 
• **Exercise** (व्यायाम): Activity requiring physical effort, carried out to sustain or improve health and fitness.
 
 
• **Example:** The exercise sheet was filled with challenging problems.
